title: 第18章 楚家出武第19章 暗杀任务
lines: 第18章楚家出武
在楚河焦急的时候，楚生手捧一个托盘，走了出来。
托盘上叠放着一件青色长袍，其正上方绘制着金色的武道印，武道印的圆形表面上印有一柄宝剑。
除此之外，长袍旁边还有一枚青色武道徽章，形状和武道印没有差别，不知道是什么材质，似玉非玉，摸起来却是一阵清凉。
“老二……你……成了！你没骗我，你真的成了！太好了！”楚河瞪大了眼睛，激动得几乎要跳了起来，死死压住想要咆哮的心情，抓住托盘，压出低沉的嗓音道。
一旁的青年，摇头一笑，似乎看到了曾经的自己。
楚生心情愉悦，笑道：“是的，大哥，我真的是武者了。”
内城街道上，楚河对着身边之人说道：“老二，要不你还是穿上武道服吧！”
“大哥，打住，你都说一路了！”楚生连连拒绝，之前死活不信自己的大哥，现在却一个劲地想炫耀，殊不知这里是内城，自己一个淬皮境初阶武者怎么敢装逼。
但是碍于大哥的苦苦哀求，楚生无奈之下，将武道徽章别在胸前。
原本衣着平庸的兄弟二人，一路上吸引了众多目光。
哪怕是在内城，对于普通人而言，武者依旧地位崇高，哪怕只是一名淬皮境武者。
唯有同样是武者的人，才会轻飘飘从楚生面前经过，不留一点目光。
一路上，楚河别说多有自豪。
昂首挺胸，走起路来都轻快许多。
在楚河的带领下，兄弟二人走到城南门口。
这时楚生才知道，家人搬到了城南区域。
但终归还是外城，安全系数依旧很低。
但是想到他现在囊中羞涩，楚生只能暂且先将此事放着。
城南区和城北区差不多，一进入其中，人员混杂，街道上臭气熏天，地痞流氓横行。
此刻，楚生披上青色长袍，金色的武道印记在太阳照耀下，显得格外刺眼。
原本混乱喧闹的街道，在见到青色长袍后，一个个安静下来。
第一个人紧张地跪下来，这一行为如同雨水滴在平静的水面上一样，不断向四周扩散。
没多久，一整条街道所有人都跪了下来，安静得可以听到油锅在炸油条的声音。
外城，基本不会有武者现身。
楚河此刻高傲得像一只大公鸡，自觉跟在楚生身后。
楚生扫视跪下的众人，表情冷漠，心中却是无限感慨。
一个月之前，他也是这群跪在地上的一员。
如今，仅仅是刚成为武者，就成了外城百姓眼中高高在上的人物。
二人在众人的注视下，走进一个巷口，再行进百米左右，才停了下来。
所经过的巷子里，一路都跪着人。
巷子中的人，瞧见楚生二人停在一个旧院子门前，心中不禁疑惑：
“这是谁家来着，怎么武者大人停在那里，莫非是这家人出了武者？嘶——！”
当二人走进院子后，巷子瞬间响起低声的议论。

Chapter 18 The Chu family takes action
When Chu He was anxious, Chu Sheng came out holding a tray in his hand.
There is a cyan robe stacked on the tray, with a golden martial arts seal drawn directly above it. A sword is printed on the circular surface of the martial arts seal.
In addition, there is a blue martial arts badge next to the robe. The shape is the same as the martial arts seal. I don’t know what kind of material it is made of. It looks like jade but not jade, but it feels cool to the touch.
"Second brother... you... have it! You didn't lie to me, you really have it! Great!" Chu He's eyes widened, and he almost jumped with excitement. He suppressed his desire to roar, grabbed the tray, and said in a deep voice.
The young man beside him shook his head and smiled, as if he saw his former self.
Chu Sheng was in a happy mood and said with a smile: "Yes, brother, I am really a warrior."
…
On the streets of the inner city, Chu He said to the people around him: "Second brother, why don't you put on your martial arts uniform!"
"Brother, stop it, you've been talking all the way!" Chu Sheng refused repeatedly. He didn't believe his brother before, but now he wants to show off, but he doesn't know that this is the inner city. How dare he, a beginner warrior of the Skin Tempering Realm, dare to show off.
However, due to his elder brother's pleading, Chu Sheng had no choice but to pin the martial arts badge on his chest.
The two brothers, who were originally plainly dressed, attracted a lot of attention along the way.
Even in the inner city, to ordinary people, a warrior still has a high status, even if he is just a skin-tempering realm warrior.
Only those who are also warriors would pass by Chu Sheng lightly without even looking at him.
Along the way, Chuhe was extremely proud.
He holds his head high and walks much more briskly.
Under the leadership of Chu He, the two brothers walked to the south gate of the city.
Only then did Chu Sheng know that his family had moved to the south of the city.
But after all, it is still an outer city, and the safety factor is still very low.
But thinking that he was short of money now, Chu Sheng could only put the matter aside for the time being.
The South District is similar to the North District. Once you enter, people are mixed, the streets are smelly, and gangsters are rampant.
At this moment, Chu Sheng put on a cyan robe, and the golden martial arts mark looked particularly dazzling under the sun.
The originally chaotic and noisy streets became quiet after seeing the blue robes.
The first person knelt down nervously, and this behavior continued to spread around like raindrops on calm water.
Not long after, everyone in the entire street knelt down, and it was so quiet that you could hear the sound of fried dough sticks being fried in a frying pan.
In the outer city, there are basically no warriors showing up.
Chu He was as proud as a big rooster at this moment, consciously following Chu Sheng.
Chu Sheng glanced at the people kneeling down, his expression indifferent, but his heart was full of emotion.
A month ago, he was one of those kneeling on the ground.
Now, just after becoming a warrior, he has become a high-ranking figure in the eyes of the people in the outer city.
Under the gaze of everyone, the two walked into an alley and walked about a hundred meters before stopping.
There were people kneeling all the way in the alleys they passed.
People in the alley saw Chu Sheng and two people parked in front of an old courtyard, and they couldn't help but wonder:
"Whose family is this? Why is the warrior master stopping there? Could it be that this family has a warrior? Hiss—!"
When the two of them entered the courtyard, low-pitched discussions erupted in the alley.
